name: Li Bang International Corporation Inc.

profile.description: Li Bang International designs, develops, produces and sells stainless-steel commercial kitchen equipment under the Li Bang brand in China, based in Jiangyin and founded in 1992. FY2025 revenue was $11.11M (+2.9% YoY) with a TTM net loss of about $1.0M; the company IPO'd on Nasdaq in October 2024 [1].

investment_thesis: Li Bang trades at $2.03 with FY2025 revenue of $11.11M (+2.9%) and a Q-level revenue of $3.14M in a recent 2026 quarter, offering exposure to Chinese commercial kitchen equipment demand at a micro-cap valuation [1]. Debt-to-equity of 136% is manageable relative to peers and the recent trading breakout drew speculative interest.
thesis_continued: Profitability is negative: ROE of -16.8%, profit margin of -9.1%, revenue down 9.6% on the latest yfinance read, and a reported EPS of -$1.28 in a recent quarter [1]. Dollar volume of ~$1.5M sits barely above the liquidity floor, and recent volume of 39,740 shares suggests it can fall below it. Sparse disclosure, China regulatory risk and likely dilution compound the risk.
